content.title: Who Is Pam Bondi's Current Boyfriend? Meet John Wakefield, Father Of 3, Present At Her Swearing In
content.text: Pamela 'Pam' Jo Bondi has been a key figure in the current political climate of the United States of America while serving as the Attorney General. She has also played a significant role in President, Donald Trump's campaigns. As a result, her professional life has always been in the spotlight. However, as Bondi continues to rise in prominence in American politics, her personal life is also under scrutiny. Pam Bondi's love life has been a tumultuous one, with divorces under her belt. She was also engaged, but the wedding was called off. However, it seems after, the Attorney General has finally found her leading man. Pam Bondi is currently in a long-term relationship with John Wakefield. Although people have noticed his presence around her frequently, not much is known about John. Who is Pam Bondi's boyfriend, John Wakefield? A review of John Wakefield's LinkedIn page reveals his distinguished career in the finance sector. He first worked as an investment banker and a wealth strategist. Now, John is the founder of a private equity firm and also the Vice President of a real estate development firm. All of his ventures have been based in his hometown of Tampa, Florida. Interestingly, Pam Bondi was also born and brought up in Tampa. John might also be a father to three children, as his bio says: "My 3 monster children are roaming the world." However, nothing else is known about the idenity of his children or their mother. But a photo posted by Pam Bondi on the occasion of his birthday showed John playing in the pool with three young girls, which could be his three daughters. Meanwhile, it is interesting to note that both of them have kept their couple photo as their Instagram profile pictures. John also has a private Instagram account with a little over 400 followers. John Wakefield attended Pam Bondi's swearing-in ceremony, and President Donald Trump called him her 'husband' During Pam Bondi's swearing-in ceremony as the Attorney General in February 2025, John Wakefield was a strong presence beside her on her big day. He even held the Bible on which Bondi took her oath. President Donald Trump also mentioned John and referred to him as Pam Bondi's husband. However, neither of them has ever confirmed being married. President Trump stated: “I just want to introduce her very, very handsome husband. I hate being around him. He looks too good. He’s been a tremendous factor with Pam and just a beautiful relationship.” Continue reading below Pam Bondi and John Wakefield have been together since 2017 reportedly Pam Bondi and John Wakefield made their relationship official with a social media post in 2017. However, before this, there had been no rumours about the two. Hence, it isn't known when exactly Bondi and John met and started dating. Since the first social media post, John has consistently been featured in Pam Bondi's Instagram posts. Before John Wakefield, Pam Bondi had been engaged to Greg Henderson. She was also married to Scott Fitzegerald and the two divorced in 2002. Prior to that, Garret Barnes was her first husband, and their marriage ended within two years in 1992.
